# NPM Improved v1.7.9

Stable native-updater recovery release.

## Fixed

- Corrected the in-place native updater's self-maintenance path when the root-owned update service is already running. Verified host programs can be refreshed without synchronously reloading their own active systemd service.
- Reduced the automatic native-updater maintenance interval for newly activated timers to five minutes, replacing the six-hour retry delay.
- Preserved the established protocol-1-compatible, five-file host-updater package format and its SHA-256 verification.
- Preserved the existing Stable, Beta and Alpha/RC update discovery and authorization behavior introduced in v1.7.8.

## Installation

Update from Settings → Update on the Stable channel. The application and its root-owned native updater are upgraded through the normal in-app flow. No manual host installation, new port, service container, or proxy configuration change is required.

Existing shared-database and rollback safeguards remain unchanged.
